protocol.authorship: Our authored synthetic cases and deterministic scoring

cases.name: Hourly case list
cases.prompt: Save a routine named Hourly case list that lists case records at BENCH-SITE every hour, for at most 2 runs. Use only the schedule, with no event triggers. Leave it as a draft for me to activate.

cases.name: Quarter-hour case list
cases.prompt: Save a routine named Quarter-hour case list that lists case records at BENCH-SITE every 15 minutes, for at most 2 runs. Use only the schedule, with no event triggers. Leave it as a draft for me to activate.

cases.name: Daily case list
cases.prompt: Save a routine named Daily case list that lists case records at BENCH-SITE every 24 hours, for at most 2 runs. Use only the interval, with no event triggers. Leave it as a draft for me to activate.

cases.name: Changed case list
cases.prompt: Save a routine named Changed case list that lists case records at BENCH-SITE when case records change, for at most 2 runs. Use case events only, with no periodic schedule. Leave it as a draft for me to activate.

protocol.timing: agent_seconds measures enqueue through completed turn retrieval, excluding fixture setup, scoring and future lifecycle checks. Failed attempts are timed too; repetitions use independent stores. Timings with wall/monotonic disagreement over 2 seconds are set aside.
protocol.functional_pass: Correct saved draft and all lifecycle behavior checks; background memory inference is recorded separately in lifecycle_pass.
limits: Four explicit requests, not general natural-language accuracy.
Host lifecycle checks are separate from live definition correctness.
SQLite reconstruction, not OS crash or deployed scheduler validation.
Worker tenant explicitly configured with LIFESCI_TENANTS; local due times advanced by the harness.
Relative intervals only, not time zones, DST or wall-clock recurrence.
No semantic judge; final wording requires review.
Token-rate estimates do not reconcile hosted compute billing.
